server-stateless.reason: The upstream structural probes require diagnostic-only tools test_missing_capability, test_streaming_elicitation and test_logging_tool. Knowledge Hub does not advertise sampling, elicitation, logging-control or those synthetic tools.

tools-list.reason: Tools are advertised and the official scenario is fully applicable.

resources-list.reason: Resources are advertised and the official scenario is fully applicable.

resources-read-text.reason: The upstream scenario is fixture-specific and requires the synthetic URI test://static-text. Product resource/read behavior is covered by the native Knowledge Hub resource contract and tests; a fixture-only resource is not added to production.

dns-rebinding-protection.reason: The loopback HTTP transport is subject to the official DNS-rebinding checks.

caching.reason: The mixed upstream cache scenario also calls prompts/list and resources/templates/list, neither of which is advertised by the Knowledge Hub native profile. Its tools/list, resources/list and resources/read cache checks remain applicable and must pass.

exclusions.reason: Knowledge Hub must not add synthetic diagnostic/image/audio/progress/embedded-resource tools solely to satisfy the upstream everything-server fixture.
Knowledge Hub must not add synthetic test:// resources solely to satisfy upstream fixture-specific scenarios.
The native profile does not advertise prompts or completion and must not fabricate those capabilities for closure evidence.
Sampling, elicitation and roots are not advertised by Knowledge Hub and are outside the P5 provider profile.
Tasks and other extensions are explicitly outside the Knowledge Hub execution-plane role.
